challenge:
RSVP Agency is an experiential agency that creates brand experiences, corporate events, weddings and private celebrations across Southern California. It grew through word of mouth and promoted its services mostly locally.

That works until a five-person team needs to know where each lead stands, who follows up and what to show a client before an event is booked. Leads and conversations lived in inboxes and in people’s heads, and the old website did little to bring in new business.
built_intro: A public website, a CRM and an internal portal that work as one system.

built.title: An optimized website
built.text: A fast, search-optimized site at [thersvpagency.com](https://thersvpagency.com) that shows the agency’s events and turns visitors into inquiries.

built.title: HubSpot CRM
built.text: A configured CRM where every lead has an owner, a stage and a next step.

built.title: Sales pipeline and connectors
built.text: A defined pipeline, plus connectors between the website, HubSpot and the team’s everyday tools, so inquiries arrive without retyping.

built.title: An internal portal
built.text: A portal for the team, built around how an event agency works day to day.

built.title: AI mockups and examples
built.text: AI generation of mockups and examples inside the portal, so a concept reaches the client far faster than building each visual by hand.

ai_title: AI where it saves creative time
ai_text: AI drafts event mockups and examples from a short brief. The team picks, edits and presents what is worth showing, and nothing goes to a client without a person approving it.
ai_points: Mockups and examples generated from a short brief
A person selects and approves every visual
Built into the internal portal, not a separate tool

outcomes.title: Found online
